# nestegg.money

> A private, zero-knowledge net worth and salary tracker. Figures are encrypted in the browser with a key derived from a random account number, so the server only ever stores ciphertext it cannot read.

nestegg also exposes its deterministic finance math as stateless calculators that any client, including AI agents, can call. The calculators are pure functions of their inputs. They never read user data, never fetch live prices or exchange rates, and carry no secrets. Any currency conversion takes the rate as an explicit input. They return numbers and schedules, never financial advice.

## Calculators

- [Calculator reference](https://nestegg.money/docs/calculators.md): description, inputs, and outputs for every calculator (99 in total). Coverage spans loans & mortgages (amortization with multi-rate steps, payoff, APR, balloon, biweekly, points, LTV/DTI, affordability), time value of money (present/future value, annuities, perpetuities, NPV/IRR, XNPV/XIRR, MIRR, payback), investing & risk (ROI, CAGR, Sharpe, drawdown, return stats, fee drag, dollar-cost averaging), bonds (price, yield to maturity, duration, convexity), options (Black-Scholes, greeks, parity), retirement (FIRE/coast/barista, portfolio longevity, contributions), real estate (cap rate, cash-on-cash, NOI, DSCR), business (WACC, break-even, margins, ratios, depreciation methods), tax (progressive brackets, after-tax & tax-equivalent yield, German payroll, VAT), and everyday money (net worth, budgeting, tips, discounts, unit price, hourly/salary). The calculators bake in no dated tax tables or rates — where statutory numbers are needed, the caller passes them in — with one deliberate exception: `de-net-salary` (below). The doc is generated from the registry, so it always matches the live tools.
- `de-net-salary`: exact German net salary (Brutto → Netto) for tax years 2023-2026 with the statutory data built in. Lohnsteuer and Soli follow the official BMF Programmablaufplan per year (2024 uses the retroactive December tariff), church tax comes from the PAP's Kirchensteuer base, and social insurance applies each year's ceilings, the official average Zusatzbeitrag, the Pflegeversicherung child rules, and the Saxony split. The engines are verified against all 1,008 published values of the official BMF Prüftabellen, so results match professional payroll software to the euro. Earlier years are rejected with a pointer to `de-gross-to-net`, where the caller supplies the figures.
- The same 2023-2026 statutory table also powers `de-abgeltungsteuer` (capital-income flat tax with the year's Sparerpauschbetrag and the §32d church-tax formula), `de-kindergeld` (child benefit per year), `de-midijob` (Übergangsbereich reduced contributions with the year's Faktor F and thresholds), and `de-rentenpunkte` (pension points via the year's Durchschnittsentgelt and aktueller Rentenwert).

## API

- JSON endpoints: `POST https://nestegg.money/api/calc/<name>` with a JSON body, JSON out. `GET https://nestegg.money/api/calc` lists the calculators. CORS-open, no auth, no storage.
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): `https://nestegg.money/mcp` exposes the same calculators as MCP tools (initialize, tools/list, tools/call) with typed outputSchema and read-only annotations. It also serves `resources/*` (the calculator docs) and `prompts/*` (mortgage-plan, fire-check, brutto-netto). Large results are compact by default: `amortization` returns a per-year summary unless `detail: "monthly"` is requested (paginated with offset/limit).
- Server descriptor: [/.well-known/mcp.json](https://nestegg.money/.well-known/mcp.json). Registry name: `io.github.VladimirWrites/nestegg-calculators` (published to the official MCP registry).

## Brutto-Netto-Rechner

- [Public net-salary calculator](https://nestegg.money/brutto-netto-rechner) (German; English
  version at [/en/german-net-salary-calculator](https://nestegg.money/en/german-net-salary-calculator)): the
  de-net-salary engine as a browser page — exact per the official BMF Programmablaufplan for
  2023-2026, fully client-side (the salary never leaves the device), free, no account.

## App

- [Live app](https://nestegg.money): the tracker. A no-account demo loads sample data at https://nestegg.money/dashboard#demo.
- [Source](https://github.com/VladimirWrites/nestegg.money): open source (Apache-2.0).

## Notes

- Zero-knowledge: the server cannot read user financial data. This work does not touch the encryption, sync, or storage layers.
- The calculators store nothing, require no authentication, and do not use live market data. Money is rounded half-up to two decimals.
